issues.issue: The placebo result text says LS mean -0.6 and TEZ/IVA 3.4, but the citation table shows N=256/245 aligned so placebo=-0.6 and TEZ/IVA=3.4 is consistent; however the p-value 'p<0.0001' and treatment difference '4.0 (3.1, 4.8)' are supported — the placebo within-group p-value in the quote is 0.06 (-1.3, 0), not flagged, so this is acceptable (note only).

N text states 'IVA N=156, TEZ/IVA N=161' as if parallel arms, but Trial 108 is a crossover study; the FAS total is 244 patients and the N=161/156/161 figures are period-level treatment counts, so labeling them as separate arm Ns misrepresents the crossover design.
The date 'August 23, 2017' derives from a citation reading '8/23/17'; the automated flag on '2017' is a false positive since the citation supports the date (low-severity note).

Citation from doc 6edf0f52 gives orphan designation date as April 24, 2014 while the summary/doc d541455b quote gives 6/15/17 for 'orphan therapy designation'; the two cited dates conflict internally.
The claim 'Transaminase elevations noted with SYMDEKO or ivacaftor' has no supporting citation quote among the three provided.

The placebo N in the result text (256 in the n field) versus the result table N=256/245 differs from the n field's 248/256 split (248 TEZ/IVA, 256 placebo vs table 245 TEZ/IVA analyzed), a minor N-set inconsistency worth noting.
